Rule_Name: RAM_req = RAM_dataset + RAM_preprocess + RAM_workers + RAM_prefetch + RAM_pinned + RAM_model_CPU + RAM_offload + RAM_checkpoint + RAM_cache + RAM_runtime

Rule_Name: RAM_stage = sum(resident dataset/shard/staging representations)
Description: Resident bytes of raw/decoded/transformed data intentionally held in host RAM
Input_Source: Direct aggregation of explicitly resident staging objects.
Condition: Hugging Face cache/in-memory dataset documentation; workload profile
Operator: Only resident representations are counted; disk-only dataset capacity is not RAM.
Unit: Dataset size on storage is not automatically RAM size.

Rule_Name: RAM_preprocess = peak concurrent bytes of preprocessing intermediates
Description: Intermediate tensors/arrays; transform outputs; temporary representations
Input_Source: Peak working-set measurement or instrumented allocation accounting.
Operator: Peak concurrency rather than cumulative allocations.
Threshold_Value: CPU preprocessing and dataset transformation pipelines.
Unit: No universal bytes/sample or overhead percentage.

Rule_Name: RAM_workers = measured/estimated sum of worker-resident memory attributable to the data pipeline
Description: num_workers; per-worker resident memory; shared memory
Input_Source: Derived from process-level memory measurement; PyTorch documents that worker memory can approach parent-process memory for accessed Python objects.
Operator: Shared memory is not double counted as private memory; representation matters.
Unit: Do not use a universal GB/worker multiplier.

Rule_Name: RAM_prefetch <= W × P × B × S_batch
Description: W = workers; P = prefetch_factor; B = batch size; S_batch = bytes per prefetched batch
Input_Source: Derived from PyTorch's worker queues/prefetch_factor semantics. It is an upper-bound planning model and should be replaced by measured peak if available.
Operator: Each queued batch is assumed to have approximately S_batch bytes and all queues are simultaneously resident.
Unit: Actual memory can differ because of collation, serialization, sharing, pinned copies and implementation details.

Rule_Name: RAM_pinned = peak resident page-locked host buffer bytes
Description: Configured pinned buffers/batches; framework allocator behavior
Input_Source: Directly measured/configured peak pinned memory. CUDA confirms page-locked host memory is host RAM and should be used carefully.
Condition: CUDA Programming Guide; CUDA Driver API; PyTorch DataLoader
Operator: Only page-locked allocations are counted; do not add them again as ordinary batch memory if same allocation.

Rule_Name: RAM_cache = configured/observed resident cache footprint
Description: Cached dataset/transform/model/request objects resident in RAM
Input_Source: Derived from configured cache size or observed resident footprint; Hugging Face explicitly supports optional in-memory datasets subject to a configured RAM limit.
Operator: Disk cache is excluded unless also resident in RAM.
Unit: Cache eviction and mmap/page-cache behavior can make OS-resident memory differ from logical cache size.

Rule_Name: RAM_model_CPU = sum(bytes of model/gradient/master-weight/optimizer tensors resident on CPU)
Description: State tensor sizes and precision
Input_Source: Direct sum of CPU-resident tensor allocations; source-backed because NeMo supports CPU offloading of optimizer states and activations.
Operator: Only tensors actually offloaded/resident on CPU are counted.
Threshold_Value: CPU offload or CPU-resident model execution.
Unit: No universal bytes/parameter multiplier is imposed.

Rule_Name: RAM_opt_offload = f_offload × RAM_optimizer_total
Description: f_offload = configured optimizer_offload_fraction; RAM_optimizer_total = total optimizer-state bytes under selected optimizer/precision
Input_Source: Derived by applying the documented offload fraction to the selected optimizer-state footprint.
Operator: Optimizer state is partitionable according to framework configuration; f_offload is explicitly configured.
Unit: Optimizer footprint must be calculated separately; no universal optimizer multiplier is introduced here.

Rule_Name: RAM_act_offload = peak bytes of configured CPU-resident activations
Description: Offloaded layers; activation size per layer; overlap/double buffering
Input_Source: Derived from peak resident activation allocations under the chosen offload configuration.
Operator: Peak rather than cumulative activation bytes; account for buffering/double buffering if enabled.
Unit: Layer count alone does not determine memory without activation shape/precision.

Rule_Name: RAM_runtime = peak host process/runtime resident set attributable to workload software
Description: RSS/PSS; framework/runtime allocations; communication/shared-memory allocations
Input_Source: Measurement-based formula: peak observed runtime footprint after separating explicitly modeled data/model/cache components.
Operator: Use a representative run and avoid double counting named components.

Rule_Name: RAM_ckpt = peak CPU-resident checkpoint staging bytes
Description: State bytes staged through CPU; checkpoint format; sharding; async mode
Input_Source: Derived from the actual checkpoint implementation. NVIDIA documents CPU copying for asynchronous checkpoint saving and sharded saving that avoids full-state gathering.
Operator: Only CPU-staged bytes are counted; direct GPU-to-storage paths without CPU staging contribute no CPU staging term.
Threshold_Value: Training configurations with CPU checkpoint staging.
Unit: Checkpoint file size on storage is not automatically RAM usage.

Rule_Name: RAM_host = RAM_shared + sum_i(RAM_private_rank_i)
Description: Shared host memory plus private memory for each GPU/rank/process
Input_Source: Derived from process/rank decomposition; avoids a universal RAM-per-GPU ratio.
Operator: Shared allocations are counted once; private rank allocations are counted per rank.
Unit: Actual process sharing varies by framework and execution mode.

Rule_Name: RAM_req,node_j = sum of peak resident components on node j
Description: Node-specific dataset shard; workers; cache; runtime; offload; checkpoint staging
Input_Source: Derived per node because distributed jobs can have different local state and shared resources.
Condition: NeMo distributed checkpointing; MLPerf system context
Operator: Each node is checked independently; cluster aggregate RAM is not a substitute.
